resources.string: 30 Days of Wellness
Day %1$d
Show or hide the tip
Drink a glass of water
Start the day with a full glass of water before coffee or your phone. Your body has gone hours without fluids.
Stretch for five minutes
Reach up, roll your shoulders and touch your toes. A short stretch wakes up your muscles and joints.
Take a short walk
Ten minutes outside clears your head and gets your blood flowing. No destination needed.
Write down three good things
Before bed, note three things that went well today, however small. It trains your mind to notice the positive.
Put your phone away for an hour
Choose one hour today with no screen. Read, cook, or simply sit and see how it feels.
Eat a piece of fruit
Swap one snack for a fresh fruit today. Vitamins, fibre and natural sweetness in one bite.
Breathe slowly
Inhale for four seconds, hold for four, exhale for six. Repeat five times to calm your nervous system.
Go to bed 30 minutes earlier
Sleep is the foundation of everything else. Give yourself a little extra rest tonight.
Call someone you care about
A five-minute conversation with a friend or relative can lift your mood and theirs.
Tidy one small space
Clear your desk or one shelf. A calmer environment makes it easier to think clearly.
Cook a meal from scratch
Prepare something simple with fresh ingredients. You control what goes in, and cooking itself is relaxing.
Learn something new
Spend 15 minutes on a topic you are curious about: a video, an article or a few pages of a book.
Sit up straight
Check your posture right now. Relax your shoulders, align your back and keep your screen at eye level.
Step outside in the sunlight
Natural light helps regulate your sleep cycle and boosts your mood. Aim for 15 minutes.
Say no to something
Protect your energy by declining one thing that does not matter to you. Boundaries are healthy.
Try a five-minute meditation
Sit quietly, close your eyes and follow your breath. When your mind wanders, gently bring it back.
Replace one sugary drink
Choose water, herbal tea or sparkling water instead of a soda or juice today.
Do ten squats
Short bursts of movement add up. Do ten squats between tasks to wake up your legs and your mind.
Give a compliment
Tell someone something you genuinely appreciate about them. Kindness feels good on both sides.
Unplug from the news
Skip the headlines for a day. Stay informed later, on your own terms and with a calmer mind.
Plan your week
Take ten minutes to outline your priorities. Knowing what is ahead reduces stress.
Eat slowly and mindfully
Put down your phone, chew thoroughly and notice the flavours. You will feel full sooner and enjoy more.
Listen to your favourite music
Put on songs that make you happy and let yourself enjoy them fully, even if just for one track.
Spend time in nature
Visit a park, garden or beach. Green and blue spaces are proven to reduce stress.
Journal for ten minutes
Write freely about what is on your mind. Getting thoughts onto paper makes them lighter.
Take the stairs
Skip the elevator today. Small choices to move more are easy wins for your heart.
Drink herbal tea in the evening
Chamomile, mint or verbena tea makes a soothing ritual before bed, without caffeine.
Forgive yourself for a mistake
Treat yourself the way you would treat a good friend. Learn from it, then let it go.
Disconnect before sleep
Turn off screens 30 minutes before bed. Your brain will wind down and your sleep will improve.
Celebrate how far you have come
Look back on the past 30 days. Every small step counts, so reward yourself for showing up.
